instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only black level. Set black level to: true dense black floor, no milk, no fog, no raised floor. Change only the black floor. High means lifted milky blacks, not crushed blacks. Do not add fill light. Do not change key direction. Do not add haze or diffusion. Do not ink mid-shadows as a density sweep. Do not change sharpness, grain, hue, or time of day.
hold_constant: Change only the black floor. High means lifted milky blacks, not crushed blacks. Do not add fill light. Do not change key direction. Do not add haze or diffusion. Do not ink mid-shadows as a density sweep. Do not change sharpness, grain, hue, or time of day.
